words.def: a statement that seems to contradict itself but may still be true
words.ex: Saying that less is more is a paradox.

words.def: comfort given to someone who is sad or disappointed
words.ex: The second-place ribbon was a small consolation after the race.

words.def: a person who worked to end slavery
words.ex: The abolitionist gave speeches calling for freedom for all.

words.def: an idea that an argument or story is based on
words.ex: The premise of the movie is that toys come alive at night.

words.def: to suggest a possible explanation that can be tested
words.ex: We hypothesize that plants will grow faster in sunlight.

words.def: the jellylike material that fills a cell around its parts
words.ex: Many chemical reactions happen in the cytoplasm.

words.def: too bad or painful to be put up with
words.ex: The noise from the drilling was intolerable.

words.def: a connection between two things that change together
words.ex: There is a correlation between practice time and test scores.

words.def: a substance that changes during a chemical reaction
words.ex: In this experiment, vinegar is one reactant and baking soda is the other.

words.def: the importance or meaning of something
words.ex: The guide explained the significance of the old bell.

words.def: to make something easier to do
words.ex: The new ramp will facilitate wheelchair access.

words.def: an imaginary line on a map running from the North Pole to the South Pole
words.ex: Each meridian on the globe marks a line of longitude.

words.def: not able to be undone or changed back
words.ex: Cutting down the old oak was an irreversible choice.

words.def: to put a plan into action
words.ex: The school will implement the new recycling program.

words.def: a time of new growth and interest in art, learning or culture
words.ex: The town is having a renaissance as artists open new shops downtown.

words.def: happening at the very same time
words.ex: The two bells gave a simultaneous ring.

words.def: never having happened before
words.ex: The town saw an unprecedented snowfall in May.

words.def: so silly or unreasonable that it is hard to believe
words.ex: The idea of a pig flying a plane is preposterous.

words.def: a person who rules in place of a king or queen who is too young or away
words.ex: The prince's uncle served as regent until the boy turned eighteen.

words.def: a statement or fact that goes against another one
words.ex: His story was full of contradiction, so no one believed it.

words.def: to weaken something gradually
words.ex: Rumors can undermine trust between friends.

words.def: a farm worker in the Middle Ages who was bound to a lord's land
words.ex: A serf could not leave the manor without permission.

words.def: to see or show how two things are not the same
words.ex: Can you differentiate a frog from a toad?

words.def: worried that something bad may happen
words.ex: She felt apprehensive before her first piano recital.

words.def: causing a lot of disagreement and argument
words.ex: Moving recess to the morning was a controversial idea.

words.def: a person in the Middle Ages who received land from a lord in return for loyalty
words.ex: The vassal promised to serve the lord faithfully.

words.def: seeming to warn of something bad
words.ex: Ominous clouds rolled in before the storm.

words.def: an ordinary citizen of ancient Rome
words.ex: A plebeian could not join the senate in early Rome.

words.def: a person chosen to speak or act for a group
words.ex: Each class picked a representative for the student council.

words.def: hard times or trouble
words.ex: The team stayed hopeful in the face of adversity.

words.def: advice about what someone should do or choose
words.ex: The librarian gave me a recommendation for a good mystery.

words.def: a member of a rich, powerful family in ancient Rome
words.ex: The patrician owned a large house with a garden.

words.def: relying on each other to survive or work
words.ex: Bees and flowers are interdependent.

words.def: taking your duties seriously and trying hard to do what is right
words.ex: A conscientious student turns in every assignment on time, even when no one is checking.
